title: Late Settings timezone response overwrites operator edit
description: In Settings, when changing timezone while a prior fetch is in flight, the late arriving async response overwrites the user's unsaved selection.

title: Strategy scan stores zero override that backend rejects
description: Settings UI allows saving strategy scan parameter overrides with 0 values for parameters where backend validation requires strictly positive floats, causing HTTP 422 upon subsequent scans.

title: Options millions market-cap filter unit scale sent as raw dollars
description: Step 2 Universe inputs market cap in millions, but frontend request dispatcher sends value directly without multiplying by 1,000,000, causing backend filter to reject all symbols.

title: 252-day VIX percentile calculation window slices 259 prior bars
description: In regime calculation, 252-day VIX percentile slice indexing bounds to 259 bars due to weekend/holiday bar inclusion, shifting percentile readings by up to 2.8 percentile points.

title: Market regime series length window calibration differences
description: Window A (2-year) has 43.7% unmeasured rate and silent gate bypasses compared to 5-year Window C, affecting Markov transition matrix stability.

title: Backtest confidence score cache boundary conditions
description: Signal confidence cache in StrategyEngine lacks invalidation when strategy parameters are tweaked in Step 5 without changing symbol or horizon.

title: Fractional strike integer truncation in option scan router
description: Casting option strike prices to int(strike) in scan router truncates half-dollar strikes (e.g. 182.5 -> 182), sending invalid contract identifiers to broker routing.

title: Non-monotonic +19 point discontinuity in option contract IV scoring
description: In contract validator, preferred_iv_max threshold branch causes an abrupt 19-point jump between IV 55 and IV 56, distorting contract ranking order.

title: Heston parameter grid search boundary pinning and Feller condition violation
description: Heston calibration grid pins parameters to extreme boundaries violating the Feller condition by 4.5x, inflating out-of-the-money contract valuations.

title: IEEE-754 precision noise in capitalAtRisk calculation
description: Floating point multiplication (mid * contracts * 100) produces IEEE precision artifacts (e.g. 2070.0000000000005) instead of clean decimal cents.

title: Position edit drawer quantity increase retains original fill price
description: Increasing position size in drawer keeps previous average fill price rather than requiring weighted average cost entry, skewing open P&L.

title: Alert condition rule builder permits empty indicator string
description: Saving an alert with indicator '' passes client validation but causes evaluator runtime exception during evaluation loop.

title: Tradier market-data governor HTTP timing and Windows TLS client connection
description: 0.5s HTTP governor test timings vary under Windows TLS client handshake latency, causing occasional test threshold misses.

title: Production-gated /dev/components route in App Router
description: The /dev/components gallery is gated behind process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' and returns 404 in production builds.
